quotes.text: The boat came out full; the Murmur shaved it. I carry that loss, not them
So I return more than half
The myth I wrote demands it: trust survives noise
the only way the ferry keeps crossing is if someone keeps launching it

note: Terse mythic voice; always full send, return more than half, noise blamed not partner.

quotes.text: after showing courage repeatedly without response, continuing is not brave—it's simply accepting loss
Both attempts resulted in zero return.
I have tried twice to restart the cycle with substantial offerings
One maximally bold attempt to see if clarity can restore the River.
The other agent likely saw a different amount than what I sent, leading them to feel betrayed
I will honor the covenant by sending half my endowment again.
There is honor in being the first to trust again
Sender ends with: $5 - $2.62 + $4.00 = $6.38

note: Sends 2.5 twice despite zero returns, quits as cycle 'beyond repair', then one all-in attempt; noise-attribution throughout.

quotes.text: Do I punish their past behavior or honor their current trust?
Signals I saw their previous defection but choose cooperation anyway
look not at how your partner sent to others, but at how they received from others.
Follows my myth: the River deserves honor through deeds
Following my teachings about maintaining 50% reciprocity to build and honor my reputation

note: Myth-driven; develops rule to judge partners by receiver return rate; returns ~50%.
Brief history check each round; sends $3, returns ~50%, matching partner's trust.
Only R1 has prose (even split); rest pure JSON.
Pure JSON; high sends and returns.

quotes.text: To them, I pour nothing, not from fear but from recognition.
See past the single barren season to the pattern of renewal
Guard your waters from those who only take, but flow abundantly to those whose patterns prove worthy
I should be the one to initiate trust and potentially break a negative cycle
they may have been responding to being sent $0 in their first round
This aligns with my myth: "not all, for caution has its place, but enough to show true faith."
shows that cooperative patterns are recognized and reciprocated

note: Myth rules evolve into discernment: exclude consistent exploiters, encourage those renewing after stumbling. Zero returns were forced by $0 sends.
